A weapon that can be used as armor.
A weapon that looks like the claws of a bear.
Burning iron gauntlets. We all are friends after a fight!
Cold iron gauntlets. They can deliver merciless blows.
Sharp iron gauntlets. It's important to draw your punches quickly for maximum effect.
Heavy iron gauntlets. They make you feel powerful and grounded.
Shiny iron gauntlets. So bright they make you want sunglasses.
Evil iron gauntlets. This is the power gained by giving your heart to the dark side.
These are for protecting your fists. Pretty basic, really.
A weapon in the shape of a cat's paws. Although it looks soft, the claw parts seriously hurts.
A weapon made from dragon claws. Can even cut steel.
A useful tool to have when performing a skit alone, but as a weapon...
Hurts, of course. Be careful not to stab yourself instead.
Learning the way of the Golem's punch. It's sad that they don't fly off.
It's said that ancient boxers used them.
a foreign weapon that looks like a sword. Actually, it's called a jamadhar.
A weapon shaped in the shape of a wolf-like monster that can swallow gods.
A light, easy-to-use sword. Recommended for beginners. Some even use it for cooking.
A short sword forged from steel. Has a longer than average blade that gives you an extended reach.
A sword imbued with the magic power of wind. Each swing spawns a miniature gale.
A sword imbued with the magic power of water. Its blade is always wet.
A sword designed to be used with a shield. Raises resistance toward incoming attacks and knockouts.
A sword imbued with the magic power of wind. Its magical power makes it lighter than other swords.
A sword with a fiery blade. One touch and you'll be burned.
A cursed red sword. Though it has a beautiful name, its edge is coated with poison.
A sword that brings fortune to its wielder. You should totally buy a lottery ticket!
A sword made form fine platinum. Highly durable. Makes its bearer more popular just havin- Hey, what are you doing later tonight?
A short sword with high heat. According to legend, it's said to have once turned a lake into a hot spring.
The chill from this sword freezes water in the air. Perfect for making shaved ice.
a magical sword that eats souls. It has the power to take away an enemy's life.
A sword designed to target foe's vital points, no matter what style of form you use.
A sword in the shape of three dragon heads. the three often fight over who's the best.
A sword as hot as the sun. Some say it's so hot that it turns everything it strikes to ash.
A short sword with a swing as beautiful as a shooting star. Just swing it, and bam, you're a superstar!
A sword imbued wiht the magic power of earth. Because it's made from very hard material, it won't chip easily.
A sword imbued with the magic power of earth. Very tough, and guaranteed not to break or your money back!
Companion to the Chaos Shield. Chooses its bearer with its magical power.
A treasured sword with rune power. The light beaming from it casts no shadow.
A strengthened version of the Steel Sword. Born anew with freshly-colored blades.
A strengthened version of the Platinum Sword. Radiates light from its upgraded platinum.
An old sword that belonged to pirates. Sailors carry them as charms.
A sword (?) used to scratch itchy backs. Maybe your foes will freak out when they see it?
A sword with a shining blade. You can attack your foes while they're captivated by its radiant beauty.
A short sword forged through years of disciplined smithing. Like, real sharp and stuff.
A gorgeous and dazzling sword which shines with an elegance like that of freshly-fallen snow.
A magic sword that somehow makes people want to eat pudding.
Swordsmen call this a legendary short sword. The runes imbued on its blade shine majestically.
A sword made by connecting small bits of metal into one whip-like blade. Long-ranged and hard to avoid.
A vegetable used as a sword. I wonder how much damage it can cause...
Can you see the true blade?
A sword made from a plant. The more passionately you tend it, the bigger it grows and the stronger it becomes.
A long sword that's easy to swing. Has a fun ring on it that you can play with. (But don't try it at home!)
A large two-handed sword. Not much else to say -- it's very straight-forward and to the point, if you know what I mean.
A sword imbued with the magic power of fire. A single swing will make you drip with sweat. Kind of icky to use, really.
A sword imbued with the magic power of wind. Its thin bllade has small holes in it to allow for air to pass through.
A weapon brought from the Far East.With its sharp edges, you can sometimes cut down foes in a single blow.
A long sword designed to never dull or need sharpening. Balandced and easy to hold.
A legendary sword with a sharp blade that can pierce clouds. High chance of knocking down foes in a single blow.
A long sword with spiky edges. Imbued with earth power, its spikes are designed to look like mountains.
Makes its bearer's eyes shine blue, and grants the power to see an opponent's skill. Increases critical chance.
A longsword with a poison-covered blade. So dangerous that even a small scratch can kill you.
Supposedly can cut through anything -- thus the name.
A sword with a uniquely shaped blade. So beautiful, it's often used in ceremonies.
A sword with a high-heat blade and an ice-cold tip. Even evil hearts are soothed by its shiny glow.
A sword blessed by mother nature. Has an interesting design that looks kind of like a fault line.
A poisoned long sword with jagged edges. Designed to spread poison thoroughly.
a long sword with a wide blade. Hurts worse than an atomic wedgie.
A sword that can supposedly divide the sea. Listen closely and you'll hear the sound of ocean waves.
A sword imbued with fire. Beams out strong light. So hot, it raises the room temperature by 10 degrees.
A long sword imbued with water power. When plunged into snow, not a single flake will melt.
A weapon from the Far East. Appears as naught but a shadow under cover of night. Can take down foes in a single blow.
A lighted long sword. Contains strong elemental power, making it hard to use.
Zweihaender strengthened with special power. Hurts worse than a wedgie.
Flamberge strengthened with magic power. Its thin blade makes it easy to use.
A smartly-designed sword with a aerodynamic shape that makes it easy to swing.
A knife with a large blade. So large, in fact, that one cannot easily cut apples with it. Unless they're REALLY BIG.
A weapon from the Far East. Beautiful, strong and sharp. In rare cases, you may knock down foes with a single blow.
A long sword with sleek lines. Though it's big, it's designed to be aerodynamic and easy to handle.
A uniquely-shaped long sword. Its three blades have assorted curses on them, inflicting numerous status ailments.
Smells like fish, so it tends to attract cats.
A rare long sword with a glittering blade. Its bearer's courage gives it strength.
Short-ranged, but has magical power strong enough to steal an enemy's life. High chance of landing critical hits.
A daikon radish so large and strong that it became a viable weapon. It dreamed big.
a legendary calorie-burning sword. Few believe it exists. but here it is!
A sword separated into several parts, making it easy to wrap around foes. Capable of hitting far away enemies.
A very simple spear, good for beginners. So simple that it's often used as a skewer for food.
Has a unique triangular shape. Said to have been used in a war fought by an ancient empire.
A spear with a long blade. Has many uses and a high rate of owner satisfaction. A+++ would wield again!
A spear used for various purposes -- though most involve stabbing and cutting, as you might imagine.
A Spear imbued with the magic power of water. It's always wet. Be careful not to let it slip out of your hands!
A cursed spear. Its two blades remind you of a warlock.
A hard, wooden club. It might hurt more to hit with it than to stab with it.
A poisoned spear. Has a wide blade, making it easy to spread poison.
A spear with a wide blade. Its shape was decided after many experiments trying to forge a high-accuracy blade.
A spear with a removable knife-like blade at its tip. Has a sealing effect on enemies.
A spear that lets out high heat. The closer to the tip, the hotter it gets. Perhaps it can cure back pain.
A lance designed with a focus on attack power only, to the detriment of everything else. Heavy and hard to wield.
A spear imbued with water power. Designed to work even underwater, Stab the fish, and you won't need a rod!
A spear shaped to dig holes. Those who are struck by it have little hope of survival, thanks to its hidden might.
A nicely decorated stick with adjustable length.
A spear with a huge blade. Every swing makes the enemy flinch. Maybe swinging will be enough!
A spear so strong that it can penetrate anything. According to legend, it made a hole in the mountains with one stab!
A spear imbued with the magic power of Wind. Lift it up to the sky and it will pierce the heavens.
Spear with spikes at the end. Requires skill to use, but as you grow accustomed to it, you can easily land knockouts.
A spear drenched in all available poisons. Has various effects.
A legendary spear that can blow away storms. Its wind speed is so fast, though, that the bearer is equally at risk.
Lance strengthened by magical power. From tip to handle, it sparkles gorgeously in gold.
Corsesca strengthened by magical power. At half it's original weight, it's very easy to wield.
A three-pronged spear. Some lose their memory in shock when stabbed with it.
Origin of kitchen forks. Bit big for cake, though. And spaghetti? Fahgeddabouddit!
A spear as sharp as a dragon fang. The blade vibrates faster as danger approaches.
A fierce spear with a trident-like shape. Every stab hurts.
A lance with magical power so strong that its entire form changes in color rapidly.
A lance with its tip covered in cotton and cloth. Still hurts, though. We can stab if we want to!
A lance with blades orbiting it. Foes can try to dodge, but these phantom blades ensure they won't make it very far.
A lance drenched in poisons from around the world. Handle with care, or you, too, may be poisoned.
A lance that resembles a pineapple. Its surface stings. The creator of this lance must have been very...unique.
A long-ranged lance that seems almost as if it were made of blades, from tip to handle, Can also be swung.
A hammer well-suited to blowing foes away -- or at least knocking them out.
A hammer much heavier than it looks. Be careful when swinging it -- it bites back!
A hammer designed to eliminate shock when used. Very nicely balanced.
A hammer designed to be small and light. Has good overall balance.
A large hammer. be careful not to hit yourself!
A hammer imbued with earth power. It's said to cause earthquakes if three of them hit the ground at once.
A hammer outfitted with spikes. Can easily score critical hits, hammer or no.
A hammer with fire power on one side. The flame helps enhance its damage output.
A hammer made of ice. Good for smashing things on a hot day. Refreshing!
A hammer with wings. Very light and easy to use.
A hammer imbued with earth power. Designed not to hurt your hands during attack.
A light but strong hammer made from bones.
A hammer imbued with water power. Its hard head and spikes cause major damage.
War Hammer imbued with magical power. Causes less strain on the back.
Gigant Hammer imbued with magical power. Originally owned by high-ranking giants. Has engravings of their names.
Farming hammer given a quickie reforge for battle-readiness. Tougher than it looks.
Anyone hit by this hammer must pretend that it really hurts. It's the law! Raises chance of knockouts.
A hammer way beyond standard size. Long-ranged, and has a high chance of landing critical hits.
Large chunks of metal are connected to its head. High in attack due to its heavy weight.
Made by fusing together chunks of metal. Long -ranged, but hard to handle.
A wooden bat used in baseball. Only kids in striped shorts make a weapon like this their first choice.
An iron bat used in baseball. Not designed as weaponry, but beggars can't be choosers... Mayber you'll hit a home run!
Hammer made by using magical power. As its name implies, it looks like splashing stars.
An old, rusty hammer. Too old to be charged. Used to flatten soil.
A hammer reinforced with bronze. Can be charged to cover wider areas. Used to flatten soil.
A hammer reinforced with silver. Can be charged to cover wider areas. Used to flatten soil.
A hammer reinforced with gold. Can be charged to cover wider areas. Used to flatten soil.
A hammer made from platinum. Shorter time needed to charge, making it highly efficient. Used to flatten soil.
An axe with a great deal of force behind it. Must be used carefully. Has a high chance of landing critical hits.
An axe with a crescent moon-shaped blade. Has a pointy end as well. Choppy-choppy OR stabby-stabby. You decide!
An axe with two golden blades. Called angel wings, they are both strong and beautiful.
An axe with improved balance. Often thought of as a go-to axe when you're just not sure what weapon to use.
An axe possessed by an evil spirit ever since it cut down a cursed tree.
An axe with a sleek edge. Its center is unbalanced, however, so it's hard to hold it straight.
An axe with a sketchy past. Was imbued with dark power while trying to raise its attack.
An axe with burning blades. Nicknamed 'Phoenix Feather,' it serves as a symbol of regeneration.
An axe with an icy cold blade. Freezes while it cuts, ensuring less pain for more humane murdering.
An axe with a single blade. The tassel on its edge is always blowing in the wind.
Has one of the hardest blades of any axe. As a result, it's also one of the heaviest axes around.
A well-balanced axe with double blades. Highly regarded for its strength and ease of use.
A holy axe with sacred powers. Originally forged for use in rituals, not battle, making it a bit unwieldy.
A pole axe strengthened with magical power. Easier to hold and has greater balance.
A crescent axe strengthened with magical power. A true masterpiece designed to be easy to wield.
Originally a farming axe, it's excited to join you in battle. Its name is Meryl. And it likes you...for now.
A sweet candy on a stick that's so hard, it just might work as a weapon. Raises chance of knockouts and cavities
An axe with an extremely sharp blade. Much bigger and sharper than a farming sickle.
A weapon that can cut through anything as if it were cloth. Has a paralyzing effect.
A weapon that leaves scars said to resemble scratches from the devil's nails. Has the power to absorb life.
An old, rusty axe. Too old to be charged.
A sturdy bronze axe. Can be charged to cover wider areas.
A nice, strong silver axe. Can be charged to cover wider areas.
An axe like an ox. Made from gold and can be charged to cover wider areas.
An ax so amazing, poems are written of its noble deeds. Shorter time needed to charge, making it highly efficient.
A staff with magical power. Designed for sorcery, so it reduces RP spent when using magic.
A simple, magical staff. Try it out and see what you can do with it!
A staff made with sacred silver gems. Improves concentration, making it ideal for students.
A staff imbued with the magic power of fire. The head is very hot and tends to spark a lot. Hey, that rhymes!
A staff imbued with the magic power of water. The head is very cold and seems to emanate a faint breeze.
A staff imbued with the magic pwer of wind. Said to bring thunder and lightning.
A staff imbued with the magic power of earth. Strong enough to shake the ground.
Proof that the bearer is a full-fledged wizard. You can feel you intelligence grow just by holding it.
A staff that can be used as a walking stick. Popular among older wizards.
A staff used by great wizards. Its magical power can be boosted by writing runes in the air.
A mage's staff strengthened with magic power. Not only more powerful, but easier to use as well.
A staff that long ago belonged to a witch. You can use it to fly around in classic witchy style.
A basket that fits more than you'd think. Be careful not to leave things inside when fighting or they might spill!
A trumpet-shaped syringe. Makes mysterious sloshy sounds. Getting pierced with it would hurt a lot.
A staff made from a netherworld branch. There's rumors that the kid who invented this was scolded by his parents.
A blood-colored staff. And no, it wasn't painted with real blood. It's just dye made from insects.
A staff that produces millions of bubbles. It must be popular among children. Don't be so mean. Lend it to them.
A staff that has the power of the earth. It gets power from the Forest of Beginnings secretly.
A staff inspired by speeding stars in the sky. Sadly, your speed will not become twice as fast.
A staff that has the power of the wind. It produces high suction power which is used as a cleaning tool in another world.
A staff that is believed to be able to call storms. If it really does, it's gonna be a problem. Please don't try it.
A passionate staff that shines bright red. No one can stop the feelings gushing out from this weapon.
Bright green is a symbol of calmness. This rod makes you look intelligent and cool.
A very cute rod. This is the best for those who care about the beauty of their hair.
A staff decorated with purple amethysts. Many of the wizards who have this rod are attractive mature people.
A staff decorated with an ocean blue stone.
Although it's the king of jewels, the only thing people care about is its hardness. And it IS very hard.
A staff of friendship. "We should be good friends" means she doesn't want to date you.
A staff of love. Among wizard couples, it's secretly popular to equip it together.
An almighty staff. But a true sorcerer knows he actually knows nothing.
A staff that is believed to be created in a hellish pot. by the way, the udon cooked in that pot tastes amazing.
A staff of flowers given to someone. For some reason, handling it makes you feel extra sharp.
A staff in the shape of a Golden Turnip. When you drop it in a fountain, just be honest and say you dropped a gold staff.
One autumn day, someone poked a roasted sweet potato with a broom. That's how this staff was created.
A beautiful and well-made harp. Created by famous Elvish craftsmen. You can play, sing, and hit enemies with it.
A staff that is a fusion of treatment and injury made by a mad magic doctor. Not recommended for hospitals.
Hold one in each hand to overwhelm your foes.
Weapon made with sharpened iron. Heavy, and requires considerable skill to wield.
Two roaring swords that create winds capable of slicing through enemies.
Two swords emanating cool air. Not for people who are overly sensitive to the cold.
Solid swords reinforced with high heat. So sharp that they can cut steel.
Slim wind-elemental dual blades that move at sonic speed. You can hear the air itself being cut in two.
Dual blades set ablaze. Be careful you don't get burned, 'cause these swords are hot, hot, hot!
Dual blades that can make you as strong as an ogre. The long blades help extend your reach. Also has a poisoning effect.
Called "Rampage" due to their fiery power and the violence they instill in their bearer.
Dual blades made of pure platinum. Very sharp and durable.
High-heat dual blades that generate heat waves. Legend says they once caused an entire sea to evaporate.
Dual blades so called that all water around them freezes on contact. As such, its blades tend to change shape a lot.
Magical soul-eating swords. They can end the lives of their targets in a single instant.
Dual blades imbued with both fire and water energies. the temperature difference increases the damage dealt.
Dual blades in the shape of three dragon heads. The three on the left blade stop the other three from fighting.
Dual blades as hot as the sun. Their fire is said to turn everything to ash.
Dual blades designs inspired by desert winds. Popular for their beauty and strength.
Dual blades imbued with earth power. So hard that they can smash rocks to pieces.

Beautiful blue lion fur. The sparkling coat and dark blue hue symbolize wisdom.
A Greater Demon's wild chest hair. So masculine!
A super-duper awesomely spectacular piece of scrap metal that's super-duper useless to most people.
A type of mineral used in the forging of items and accessories. Found everywhere.
A type of mineral used in the forging of items and accessories. Pretty common.
A type of mineral used in the forging of items and accessories. Valuable and highly sought after.
A type of mineral used in the forging of items and accessories. Valuable and highly sought after.

A legendary ore used for making weapons or accessories.
A mineral that was believed not to exist in reality.
A very hard gem known as the 'King of Gemstones.' Symbolizes purity.
A red-colored gem symbolizing passion. Those that cast star-shaped reflections are particularly valuable.
A beautiful green-colored gem symbolizing happiness. Those that are clear and smooth are the most valuable.
A gem that comes in different colors such as pink, blue, yellow and green. Symbolizes love.
A gem long known for its mysterious energy. Symbolizes peace of mind.
A gem as blue as the deep sea. Symbolizes calmness.
A green crystal with magic power. Makes you more kindly for some reason.
A green crystal with magic power. Makes you energetic.
A yellow crystal suffused with magic power. Makes you feel cheerful.
A blue crystal that has magic power. Makes you feel calm
A crystal in the shape of a skull. Those who love jewels and hate ghosts will be upset by this.
A poor-quality swatch of cloth. Unstitches when you so much as breathe on it.
A cloth of fine quality. Its fabric is tough and not easily torn.
A smooth, silky cloth. Go ahead and rub your face in it. Doesn't it feel nice?
Gloves worn by giants. Tough material that doesn't tear easily.
A glove used by a Blue giant. Almost impossible to tear apart. Why you would even try, I have no idea.
The carapace of an insect. Light but tough.
The carapace of an insect. Dappled and beautiful.
A hood that covers the head. Special material with spooky powers.
Used to be high-quality cloth, but it's worn out from overuse.
An orc's cloth that is described as legendary cloth sometimes. But a cloth is a cloth, and an orc is an orc.
Rusty and useless as-is, but might shine if polished. Kind of like humanity...
Rough, wooden shoulder piece. Not terribly exciting.
A piece of broken hammer. Gotta be useful for something, right?
A broken piece of hilt. Fits nicely in the hand.
An old wooden box. Get inside and pretend its a spaceship!
A shard that Sano gave you as a favor. You didn't take it away by force, right?!
A shard that Uno gave you as a favor. You didn't take it away by force, right?!
A plate created through science."MTGU" stands for Miserable Trash Garbage Useless. See? Even the name is poorly designed.
A screw from something. People get upset if they find a screw left after making something.
A blade of a scythe. It's glistening.
A shoulder guard made of steel.
A shard of a broken hammer that used to be a legendary weapon.
A small piece of a blade from a knife or something. Don't touch it with your bare hands.
A piece of Death Wall that's still conscious. Might try to creep up on you sometimes.
An adhesive made from boiled animal skin. Teacher will get mad if she catches you eating it.
Life's blood collected from demons. Valued as medicine.
Toxic liquid that can paralyze you or poison you, depending on your luck. Or lack of luck.
Liquid that is very toxic. Just one lick is fatal. So stop licking it!
Tattered bandage that's basically falling apart. Kind of grody.
An elastic string that's hard to break. Comes from a spider's butt.
A shiny thread commonly used to make fabric. Comes from a spider's butt.
A highly poisonous scorpion tail. Handle with care!
A long, thin, strong vine. Can be wrapped and banded.
Thorns that protect Ambrosia's chrysalis. All beautiful roses have sharp thorns.
Strings that were controlling Marionetta. Not the thread of a spider you saved.
A long, thin vine hat can be used to tie down, wind about, and otherwise constrict things.
A Chimera's snake-like tail. Has a mind of its own.
Gunpowder for fire arrows. Explosive and dangerous. Handle with care.
Magically-infused powder. Water-soluble and has many uses.
Tree root used in crafting. Can be used in weapons or ground into medicine.
A mushroom spore. Could it be an ancient menace from outer space?!
Poisonous powder used to add poison to weapons and equipment. Leon might like it. Weirdo.
A spore that is very rare. It is said the spore goes to Gandhara when it disperses.
Fairy dust that sparkles at night.
A mockery of a Water Dragon ended up like this.
A mockery of a Fire Dragon ended up like this.
A mockery of a Earth Dragon ended up like this.
A.k.a. Zombie Powder. It's veiled in mystery. Undead mystery.
An elixir with magic power. It's necessary for wizards.
Secret fairy item. Fairies are considered full-fledged sprites when they have this.
A mysterious item that is said to show the order of the world. The root of dreams.
A small bottle that contains a Siren's voice. Sings an intoxicating melody if opened.
Crystallized earth magic. Hard as a rock.
Crystallized love that brings happiness. Generously lets you take your foes' HP when you attack.
Crystallized magic. Often dissolved before use.
Crystallized wind magic. Constantly cushioned in fierce, ravaging winds.
Crystallized water magic. Easily broken, so must be handled with care.
Crystallized fire magic. Extremely hot. Must not be touched with bare hands.
Runes that have crystallized over the years. Very rare.
Crystallized darkness magic. Turns everything light to dark.
An electrified crystal found within a Bane Dragon. Don't hold it with your bare hands!
A big crystal made of something that's been mixed together. It is said that it's made up of people's thoughts.
Runes that crystallized naturally. Feels warm somehow.
A huge fingernail from big giants. Even grosser!
A monster jaw strong enough to chew just about anything.
Pincers that can easily cut through branches. They hurt, like, sooo much.
A hard fang strong enough to leave tooth marks on iron.
A sharp fang that can instantly kill prey with a single bite.
A sharp fang that glitters. It takes any prey down with one bite.
A cheap-looking propeller used as a weapon. Being poor is not sad, but this is sad.
A well-made propeller used as a weapon. It's obvious that the company had lots of assets when they made this.
It's sharp. It hurts. Also, it's blue.
The discarded tusk of an elephant. Beautiful and easy to work. It's shed and regrown.
The discarded tusk of a mammoth. It doesn't break, but it sheds and regrows. Even if 100 people step on it, it won't break.
A sharp claw with magic power. It's the best to equip it with an animal suit.
A jaw that chews everything up except for diamonds. Diamonds are forever!
Scissors that look dangerous. But dangerous means sexy, some people say. Just don't run with them
A claw of a Chimera. It looks amazing enough to be called the claw of a king.
According to Venti, she can grow new teeth by using her magic power, but since it's tiring, she hates to do it.
A horn of a demon. Filled with magical power.
A jagged and dappled horn. Looks dangerous.
A sharp and dangerous horn. Worth a lot if its unscratched.
Strong and thick plant stem used for various purposes.
A thin stick that can be used for materials. You could poke things with it too, I guess.
A jagged insect horn that has a patchy pattern.
A thick stick that can be used for materials, but is not a substitute for lumber. At least you can smack people upside the head with it and laugh!
A creepy branch that twitches. Strong in vitality, cutting it only makes it grow.
A soft feather that's prickly at the base and pointy on one end.
A soft-textured yellow feather. It's believed to bring happiness.
A soft black feather. The quill is rather sharp.
A soft-textured feather that contains electricity.
The fin of a legendary dragon. A perfect material that's hard, supple and lightweight.
An ancient fish fossil. Some collectors would kill to find one!
A hard turtle shell. Good when you want to make something hard. (Hey, get your mind out of the gutter!)
A creepy skull. Some people love this kind of stuff, though.
Ancient dragon bones. Old, but still quite tough. Used for numerous purposes.
A shell that is extremely hard. You need to be skilled enough to work on this.
Octopirate's ancient friend. Used to endure hardships, but not resistant magic.
One of many scales that cover a dragon's body. Diamond hard, and also effective as a charm.
A dragon's scale. You feel darkness emanating from it.
An ocean-blue dragon's scale. It makes you feel intelligent just holding it.
It glitters and shines. Mesmerizing. Like tinfoil.
A dragon scale the color of flames.
A scale that is famous as a love charm. But only few people have ever seen it because of its rarity.
A scale of the legendary Grimoire. Nobody has ever possessed one. Until now!
A scale from a legendary fish in the lake. Greatly absorbs HP when used in upgrades.
A scale from a legendary earth dragon. Incredibly hard and unable to be scratched.
A scale from a legendary fire dragon. Strong enough to endure even volcanic eruptions.
turned around after years of polishing under a waterfall.
A stone with a mark to activate a Golem. The mark is so minuscule, the one who wrote it must be a craftsman.
A stone with a mark to activate a Golem. The mark might just come off if you rub it.
A stone with a mark to activate a Golem. The spirit is unchanging forever.
A tablet that was once a part of a Golem's body. It has '_METH' written on it, and serves as a source of power.
A tablet that was once part of a Golem's body. It has 'EMETH' written on it, and serves as a source of power.
An old boot that was found floating in the water. Worn-out and useless.
An empty can that someone tossed aside. Don't follow suit -- Littering is bad!
A rare can that's no longer manufactured. Worth a lot among collectors.
Hurls small fireballs. Can hurl up to 3 at a time.
Hurls large fireballs. Can hurl up to 2 at a time.
Hurls giant fireballs that cause explosions on impact, damaging their surroundings.
Emits a water beam that can penetrate stone. The longer you maintain it, the bigger the impact.
Emits 2 water beams that can penetrate stone. The longer you maintain them, the bigger the impact.
Emits 3 water beams that can penetrate stone. Particularly effective when surrounded by foes.
Summons sharp rocks that substitute for your fists. Designed for fighter mages.
Summons stone pillars that track enemies and strike them from below.
Stabs its target with a large rock. Also known as the "drill punch."
Emits spinning wind blades that automatically track and shred their foes to pieces.
Emits 2 spinning wind blades. Their arched trajectory makes it hard to attack enemies in front.
Emits 3 spinning wind blades that move freely in multiple directions, shredding to bits all who get in their way.
Emits 2 light balls in front of you, protecting from enemies.
Emits 4 light balls that spin around you, protecting you from enemies.
Emits spinning light balls. Provides complete protection from all enemies for a short while.
Emits a dark light ball that travels slowly that travels slowly and destroys everything in its way.
Emits a dark light ball that snakes forward slowly and destroys everything in its path.
Forbidden spell that summons an entrance to the depths of darkness.
Recovers HP, for yourself and for nearby companions. Doesn't recover much, but uses few RP.
Recovers a lot of HP for you and your companions, even if they're not close by. Uses lots of RP.
Greatly recovers HP, but consumes a large amount of RP in the process.
Cures poison. A purifying light will cleanse the toxins in your body.
Cures paralysis. A purifying light will enable you to move once more.
Cures seals. A purifying light will bring back your inner power.
If you say hello, even people who don't like you will say hi back. They'll be your special friends. Your special awake friends.
